notes: Address confirmed: the ordering page's embedded store record reads 919 Mannheim Rd, Bellwood, IL 60104, tel 708-544-8766, and aristongyros.com/menu.html (which also prints that address) links to it as 'Order Now' / 'See Full Menu'. Ariston's own menu.html lists the Hungry Men's Menu and Meal Deals item names but publishes NO prices, so prices come from the linked ordering page (pickup service), read from the page's embedded menu data on 2026-11-10. These are online-ordering prices; they end in unusual cents (e.g. $18.69, $13.19, $9.89), which may mean an online markup over counter prices — not confirmed either way, and the counter menu board was not seen. The ordering menu has 25 categories; the six here are the two the restaurant leads with on its own site plus its gyro, rib, Italian beef and wings sections, each cut to the first 8 items in menu order. Category notes from the source: Hungry Men's Menu 'All Specials Include Large Fries & Large Drink'; Meal Deals 'All Specials Include Fries & Medium Drink'; Greek Specialties 'Choice of Our Own Signature Sauce or Cucumber Sauce (Tzatziki)'. Item numbers (#01…) are the restaurant's own. Categories not included: Garden Spot, Side Orders, Loaded Fries, Turkey Lovers, Frankly Yours, Char Broiled Burgers, Specialty Sandwiches, Croissants, Cold Sandwiches & Melts, Chicken / Poultry, Oven Baked Chicken, Seafood, Steak, South of The Border (4 categories), Kids Menu, Drinks & Desserts.
